what: ERROR from design-pause-load is dropped from the proposed result contract
scenario_or_breakage: design-pause-load.sh emits LOAD_OK=false ERROR=<token> for expected restore failures, and current Step 0b says those ERROR lines are printed before falling through. The plan forwards ERROR in responsibilities but omits ERROR from the result-env allowlist, so malformed pause markers or missing snapshots can degrade to a fresh run without surfacing the reason.
suggested_fix: Add ERROR to the design-route result allowlist and require the orchestrator to re-emit ERROR lines as warnings on LOAD_OK=false fallthrough.

what: New invoked driver scripts are not pinned executable
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed SKILL.md will invoke both new scripts by path. If they land with the default non-executable mode, Step 0b fails with permission denied before routing or run-params setup. Existing adjacent driver coverage pins run-step3-review.sh as executable.
suggested_fix: Make both new .sh files executable and add test-design-structure.sh assertions that design-route.sh and design-init-runparams.sh are executable.
